jobs.description:
Do you look for a new challenge within the dynamic and fast paced Wealth Management environment? Do you want to be part of a high performing team? Do you have a "can do" mentality and want to be part of our growth story and create impact? Do you want to proactively go the extra mile with us to help our sophisticated clients? Are you curious, proactive and always striving to bring positive impact to clients?

We’re looking for a client account manager to:

• manage daily business in PC / HNW client servicing and provide high quality service
• be the point of entry for processing client orders, e.g. stock orders, foreign exchange, loans and deposits
• be the direct contact for daily banking activities and administrative work for our clients
• manage daily client transactions and carry out inquiries and troubleshooting
• perform account maintenance tasks and client-related processes; e.g. account opening and closing, suitability reviews, initial and recurring KYC and due diligence
• research, follow-up and resolve client inquiries and problems through effective interaction with clients, and internal partners in a timely and professional manner
• identify cross-selling opportunities and discuss them with the client advisor
• support client advisors in delivering exceptional client service and experience, taking care of administrative, risk and legal & compliance related tasks and duties
• support client advisors when they are on business trips and assist in preparing client meetings
• join client advisors occasionally in client meetings

descriptionByLocale.it:
Cerchi una nuova sfida all'interno dell'ambiente dinamico e veloce di Wealth Management? Vuoi fare parte di una squadra ad alte prestazioni? Hai una mentalità "può fare" e vuoi far parte della nostra storia di crescita e creare impatto? Vuoi proattivamente andare il miglio extra con noi per aiutare i nostri clienti sofisticati? Siete curiosi, proattivi e sempre impegnati a portare un impatto positivo ai clienti?

Stiamo cercando un account manager cliente per:

• gestire il business quotidiano in PC / HNW servizio client e fornire un servizio di alta qualità
• essere il punto di ingresso per l'elaborazione degli ordini del cliente, ad esempio ordini azionari, cambio estero, prestiti e depositi
• essere il contatto diretto per le attività bancarie quotidiane e il lavoro amministrativo per i nostri clienti
• gestire le transazioni quotidiane del cliente e effettuare richieste e risoluzione dei problemi
• eseguire attività di manutenzione dell'account e processi relativi al cliente; ad esempio apertura e chiusura dell'account, recensioni di idoneità, KYC iniziale e ricorrente e due diligence
• ricerca, follow-up e risolvere le richieste e i problemi dei clienti attraverso un'interazione efficace con i clienti, e partner interni in modo tempestivo e professionale
• identificare le opportunità di cross-selling e discutere con il consulente del cliente
• sostenere i consulenti clienti nella fornitura di un servizio e di un'esperienza clienti eccezionali, occupandosi di compiti e doveri amministrativi, di rischio e di conformità
• sostenere i consulenti dei clienti quando sono in viaggio d'affari e assistere nella preparazione delle riunioni dei clienti
• unire i consulenti dei clienti occasionalmente in riunioni dei clienti
descriptionByLocale.de:

Avez-vous une mentalité "peut faire" et voulez-vous faire partie de notre histoire de croissance et créer un impact? • gérer les affaires quotidiennes dans le service client PC / HNW et fournir un service de haute qualité
• être le point d'entrée pour le traitement des commandes des clients, p.ex. commandes d'actions, devises, prêts et dépôts
• être le contact direct pour les activités bancaires quotidiennes et le travail administratif pour nos clients

• la recherche, le suivi et la résolution des demandes de renseignements et des problèmes des clients par une interaction efficace avec les clients et les partenaires internes en temps opportun et de manière professionnelle;
• identifier les possibilités de vente croisée et en discuter avec le conseiller client
• aider les conseillers clients à fournir un service et une expérience exceptionnels à la clientèle, en prenant soin des tâches et des tâches administratives, juridiques et liées à la conformité
• appuyer les conseillers clients lorsqu'ils sont en voyage d'affaires et aider à préparer les réunions des clients;
• se joignent occasionnellement à des conseillers clients lors de réunions avec des clients

jobs.title: Portfolio Risk Analyst
jobs.description:
The Global Wealth Management Banking Americas group offers products and services to UBS Financial advisors and clients to help them meet their financial needs and goals. The products and offerings include loans to High New Worth (HNW) and Ultra High Net Worth (UHNW) clients of the firm. The Credit Risk Manager role is part of the team’s 1st line of defense support.

• Lead Mumbai Lending team to support onshore team in managing a portfolio of loans to HNW and UHNW clients consisting of various collateral types including but not limited to Marketable Securities, Private Equity, Hedge Funds, LP interests, and Unsecured
• Assist in preparing high quality credit presentations within defined periodic review due dates that accurately summarize the loan purpose, terms and conditions, sources of repayment, risks, credit strengths and weaknesses
• apply financial principles, theories, concepts, and techniques to analyze information and loan collateral in accordance with policies, procedures, and industry practice
• keep current on major developments and changes in market and client financial condition to identify and escalate potential negative trends that could lead to the deterioration of credit quality and internal ratings
• maintain and update borrower’s loan data in internal systems and trackers
• participate in the development and ongoing updates to process and procedure documents

Il gruppo Global Wealth Management Banking Americas offre prodotti e servizi ai consulenti finanziari e ai clienti UBS per aiutarli a soddisfare le loro esigenze e obiettivi finanziari. I prodotti e le offerte includono prestiti ai clienti High New Worth (HNW) e Ultra High Net Worth (UHNW) dell'azienda. Il ruolo di Credit Risk Manager è parte della prima linea di supporto della squadra.

• Lead team di Mumbai Lending per supportare il team onshore nella gestione di un portafoglio di prestiti a clienti HNW e UHNW costituito da vari tipi di garanzie, tra cui ma non limitato a Marketable Securities, Private Equity, Hedge Funds, interessi LP, e Unsecured
• Assistere nella preparazione di presentazioni di credito di alta qualità all'interno della revisione periodica definita date che riassumono con precisione lo scopo del prestito, i termini e le condizioni, le fonti di rimborso, i rischi, le forze di credito e le debolezze
• applicare i principi finanziari, le teorie, i concetti e le tecniche per analizzare le informazioni e il prestito collaterale in conformità a politiche, procedure e pratiche industriali
• mantenere corrente sui principali sviluppi e cambiamenti del mercato e delle condizioni finanziarie del cliente per identificare e aumentare le potenziali tendenze negative che potrebbero portare al deterioramento della qualità del credito e valutazioni interne
• mantenere e aggiornare i dati di prestito del mutuatario nei sistemi interni e tracker
• partecipare allo sviluppo e aggiornamenti in corso ai documenti di processo e procedura
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Gruppe Global Wealth Management Banking Americas bietet UBS Finanzberatern und Kunden Produkte und Dienstleistungen an, um sie bei der Erfüllung ihrer finanziellen Bedürfnisse und Ziele zu unterstützen. Die Produkte und Angebote umfassen Kredite an High New Worth (HNW) und Ultra High Net Worth (UHNW) Kunden des Unternehmens. Die Rolle des Credit Risk Managers ist Teil der ersten Verteidigungslinie des Teams.

• Führen Sie das Mumbai Lending Team, um das Onshore-Team bei der Verwaltung eines Portfolios von Krediten an HNW- und UHNW-Kunden zu unterstützen, die aus verschiedenen Sicherheiten bestehen, darunter, aber nicht beschränkt auf Marketable Securities, Private Equity, Hedge Funds, LP-Interessen und Unsecured
• Unterstützung bei der Vorbereitung hochwertiger Kreditpräsentationen innerhalb definierter periodischer Überprüfungstermine, die den Kreditzweck, die Bedingungen, die Rückzahlungsquellen, die Risiken, die Kreditstärken und Schwächen genau zusammenfassen
• Anwendung finanzieller Prinzipien, Theorien, Konzepte und Techniken zur Analyse von Informationen und Kreditsicherheiten in Übereinstimmung mit Richtlinien, Verfahren und Branchenpraktiken
• halten Sie sich über wichtige Entwicklungen und Veränderungen der Markt- und Kundenfinanzlage auf dem Laufenden, um potenzielle negative Trends zu identifizieren und zu eskalieren, die zu einer Verschlechterung der Kreditqualität und interner Ratings führen könnten
• Pflege und Aktualisierung der Kreditdaten des Kreditnehmers in internen Systemen und Trackern
• an der Entwicklung und den laufenden Aktualisierungen von Prozess- und Verfahrensdokumenten teilnehmen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Le groupe Global Wealth Management Banking Americas offre des produits et des services aux conseillers et clients financiers d'UBS pour les aider à répondre à leurs besoins et objectifs financiers. Les produits et les offres comprennent des prêts à des clients de la firme High New Worth (HNW) et Ultra High Net Worth (UHNW). Le rôle de gestionnaire de risque de crédit fait partie de l'équipe de 1ère ligne de soutien de la défense.

• Chef de l'équipe de prêt de Mumbai pour appuyer l'équipe côtière dans la gestion d'un portefeuille de prêts aux clients de HNW et de l'UHNW comprenant divers types de garanties, y compris, sans s'y limiter, les valeurs mobilières négociables, les actions privées, les fonds de couverture, les intérêts LP et les garanties non garanties
• Aider à préparer des présentations de crédit de haute qualité dans le cadre des dates d'échéance de l'examen périodique qui résument avec précision l'objectif du prêt, les modalités, les sources de remboursement, les risques, les points forts et les faiblesses du crédit
• appliquer les principes financiers, les théories, les concepts et les techniques pour analyser l'information et les garanties de prêt conformément aux politiques, procédures et pratiques de l'industrie
• tenir à jour les principaux développements et changements dans la situation financière du marché et de la clientèle pour identifier et intensifier les tendances négatives potentielles qui pourraient conduire à la détérioration de la qualité du crédit et des notations internes
• tenir et mettre à jour les données sur les prêts de l'emprunteur dans les systèmes internes et les trackers
• participer à l'élaboration et aux mises à jour continues des documents sur les processus et les procédures

jobs.description:
Are you a seasoned lending professional with deep Lombard expertise and a strong sense of ownership? Do you enjoy leading people while remaining hands on in complex transactions and strategic initiatives?
We are looking for a Director – Team Lead Lombard Lending & Deposits to lead the delivery of secured lending and deposits solutions in Taiwan. This is a senior role combining client-facing origination, product ownership and line management responsibility, with accountability for business growth, risk stewardship and people development.
In this role, you will be accountable for:
Lombard Lending Origination & Structuring
• act as the senior subject matter expert for Lombard lending in Taiwan, supporting Client Advisors and clients across the end to end financing lifecycle
• originate, structure and execute complex and bespoke Lombard lending transactions
o act as transaction lead for higher-risk or strategically important cases
o provide subject matter expertise and guidance for smaller/ less complex transactions
• develop and promote leverage solutions to client advisors to generate client interest and leverage demand
• drive sales momentum and conversion by identifying lending opportunities within existing and new client relationships
• provide expert guidance on pricing, leverage, structuring and risk trade offs, ensuring appropriate and sustainable use of credit
• participate in selected direct client interactions alongside Client Advisors to support origination, execution and client education
Deposits Business Ownership & Pricing
• serve as the local functional owner for the deposits business in Taiwan, with responsibility for product oversight, pricing discipline and commercial outcomes
• perform deposit pricing and balance sheet analysis, supporting business decisions and sales initiatives
• design and drive deposit sales campaigns in close partnership with control functions and frontline leadership
• liaise with Group Treasury and Investment Banking on funding considerations, pricing frameworks and group balance sheet preferences
• ensure clear and consistent communication of deposit strategy, pricing guidance and constraints to the business
People & Line Management
• line manage, coach and develop two team members, setting clear objectives and supporting their professional growth
• allocate deal responsibilities and product tasks appropriately, ensuring high-quality execution and knowledge transfer
• foster a strong team culture grounded in collaboration, accountability, risk awareness and client focus
• provide structured feedback, performance input and career guidance in line with UBS people principles
Product, Risk & Control Responsibilities
• maintain ownership of the local Lombard and deposits product shelf, including product maintenance, governance and pricing frameworks
• ensure compliance with local regulation and UBS internal policies, fulfilling first-line risk management responsibilities
• oversee portfolio monitoring, reporting and issue remediation in partnership with Risk, Legal and Compliance
• stay abreast of market developments, competitor activity and regulatory change, proactively adapting local offerings
Strategy, Change & Stakeholder Management
• develop and execute local lending and deposits growth strategies aligned with regional and global objectives
• contribute to new product development and enhancement initiatives with Global Lending distribution teams
• act as the local interface with IT and change teams on system enhancements, process improvements and digitisation initiatives
• collaborate extensively across Wealth Management, Credit Risk, Investments and Banking to deliver integrated client solutions

The position requires strong organizational skills, discretion, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, executive-facing environment.

This is an in-office role based in the Salt Lake City headquarters and requires regular on-site presence to support business and leadership needs.

Key Responsibilities:

Office Operations & Coordination
• Serve as a key operational contact for the UBS Bank USA Salt Lake City headquarters office.
• Coordinate office operations, including visitor management, seating arrangements, executive meeting logistics, and general administrative support.
• Partner with Facilities, Security, and the Salt Lake City management team to ensure smooth and efficient office operations.
• Support broader office management activities, including oversight of supplies, equipment, and workspace organization.

Executive & Governance Support
• Provide administrative support to the Head of Governance, including calendar management, meeting preparation, and coordination of priorities.
• Coordinate management committee and governance-related meetings, including scheduling, attendee tracking, materials preparation, and logistics, as needed.

Meetings, Events & Executive Engagement
• Assist in planning and coordinating onsite leadership meetings, town halls, and executive visits.
• Provide on-site support for the visiting senior executives (CEO, President), ensuring a seamless experience during visits to Salt Lake City.

Administrative & Operational Support
• Manage procurement requests, including approval and coordination of office supplies and equipment purchasing.
• Coordinate travel arrangements and expense reporting for the Head of Governance.
• Maintain and administer filing systems (electronic and manual), ensuring accuracy, accessibility, and compliance with organizational policies.
• Handle incoming communications, including calls and mail, with professionalism and discretion.
Perform and coordinate routine and specialized administrative tasks as needed to support business priorities
descriptionByLocale.it:
Il Coordinatore dell'Assistente e dell'Ufficio è fondamentale per garantire l'efficace coordinamento delle priorità esecutive e delle operazioni di ufficio quotidiane. La posizione richiede forti capacità organizzative, discrezionali e la capacità di gestire più priorità in un ambiente veloce e diretto.

Questo è un ruolo in-office basato nella sede di Salt Lake City e richiede una regolare presenza in loco per sostenere le esigenze di business e leadership.

Responsabilità chiave:

Operazioni e coordinamento degli uffici
• Servire come un contatto operativo chiave per l'ufficio centrale UBS Bank USA Salt Lake City.
• Coordinate le operazioni di ufficio, compresa la gestione dei visitatori, le disposizioni di seduta, la logistica di riunione executive e il supporto amministrativo generale.
• Partner con Servizi, Sicurezza e il team di gestione Salt Lake City per garantire operazioni di ufficio fluide ed efficienti.
• Supporta attività di gestione degli uffici più ampie, tra cui la supervisione di forniture, attrezzature e organizzazione del lavoro.

Supporto esecutivo e governo
• Fornire supporto amministrativo al Capo della Governance, compresa la gestione del calendario, la preparazione delle riunioni e il coordinamento delle priorità.
• Coordinate comitato di gestione e incontri legati alla governance, tra cui pianificazione, monitoraggio dei partecipanti, preparazione dei materiali e logistica, secondo le necessità.

Incontri, Eventi & Engagement Esecutivo
• Assistere nella pianificazione e coordinare riunioni di leadership in loco, sale comunali e visite esecutive.
• Fornire supporto in loco per i dirigenti senior in visita (CEO, Presidente), garantendo un'esperienza senza interruzioni durante le visite a Salt Lake City.

Supporto amministrativo e operativo
• Gestire le richieste di approvvigionamento, compreso l'approvazione e il coordinamento delle forniture di ufficio e l'acquisto di attrezzature.
• Coordinare le modalità di viaggio e la rendicontazione delle spese per il Capo della Governance.
• Mantenere e amministrare i sistemi di archiviazione (elettronici e manuali), garantire accuratezza, accessibilità e conformità alle politiche organizzative.
• Mantenere le comunicazioni in arrivo, incluse le chiamate e la posta, con professionalità e discrezione.
Eseguire e coordinare compiti amministrativi di routine e specializzati secondo le necessità di sostenere le priorità aziendali
descriptionByLocale.de:

descriptionByLocale.fr:

• Coordonner les réunions du comité de gestion et de la gouvernance, y compris le calendrier, le suivi des participants, la préparation du matériel et la logistique, au besoin.

• Fournir un soutien sur place aux cadres supérieurs en visite (CEO, président), en assurant une expérience transparente pendant les visites à Salt Lake City.

Soutien administratif et opérationnel
• Gérer les demandes d'achat, y compris l'approbation et la coordination des achats de fournitures et de matériel de bureau.

• Gérer les communications entrantes, y compris les appels et le courrier, avec professionnalisme et discrétion.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about applying quantitative methods to real-world investment challenges? Do you thrive in a collaborative environment where your portfolio construction skills and analytical thinking can drive innovation in portfolio risk management?

We’re looking for someone who can:

• Perform and document comprehensive reviews of discretionary investment strategies managed by U.S. Financial Advisors (FAs), with a detailed focus on investment process, dispersion analysis, performance, trading implementation, and related operational controls.
• Engage Financial Advisor (FA) teams to explain Investment Manager Analysis (IMA) observations and provide targeted coaching designed to strengthen their investment decision-making and drive improved long-term portfolio outcomes.
• Contribute to recurring governance meetings/committees for discretionary strategies; set agendas, curate materials, coordinate key stakeholders, and ensure decisions, actions, owners, and timelines are clearly captured; drive escalations and follow ups to closure.
• Serve as a subject matter expert for our discretionary programs; field questions from FA teams and cross functional partners, providing timely, well supported guidance on program design, oversight standards, and best practices.
• Participate in evolving the strategic vision for discretionary programs to ensure robust oversight and governance frameworks while preserving each FA’s ability to effectively navigate and manage discretionary portfolios.
• Curate and continuously improve review artifacts (e.g., strategy review packs, dispersion/performance readouts, trading checklists) to support both initial due diligence and ongoing monitoring.
• Partner across stakeholders to translate insights into pragmatic enhancements to process, controls, and client outcomes, reinforcing accountability and transparency throughout the program lifecycle.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei appassionato di applicare metodi quantitativi alle sfide di investimento del mondo reale? Si prospera in un ambiente collaborativo in cui le competenze di costruzione del portafoglio e il pensiero analitico possono guidare l'innovazione nella gestione del rischio di portafoglio?

Stiamo cercando qualcuno che possa:

• Eseguire e documentare valutazioni esaurienti delle strategie di investimento discrezionali gestite da U.S. Financial Advisors (FA), con un focus dettagliato sul processo di investimento, l'analisi della dispersione, le prestazioni, l'implementazione di trading e i relativi controlli operativi.
• Engage Financial Advisor (FA) team per spiegare le osservazioni di Investment Manager Analysis (IMA) e fornire coaching mirato progettato per rafforzare il loro processo decisionale di investimento e migliorare i risultati del portafoglio a lungo termine.
• Contribuire alle riunioni di governance/comitati ricorrenti per le strategie discrezionali; impostare gli ordini del giorno, curare i materiali, coordinare le parti interessate chiave, e garantire decisioni, azioni, proprietari e tempeste sono chiaramente catturati; guidare escalation e seguire fino alla chiusura.
• Servire come esperto di materia tematica per i nostri programmi discrezionali; domande sul campo da parte dei team FA e cross partner funzionali, fornendo una guida tempestiva e ben supportata sulla progettazione del programma, gli standard di supervisione e le migliori pratiche.
• Partecipate ad evolvere la visione strategica per i programmi discrezionali per garantire robusti framework di supervisione e governance, preservando la capacità di ogni FA di navigare e gestire efficacemente i portafogli discrezionali.
• Curare e migliorare continuamente gli artefatti di revisione (ad esempio, pacchetti di revisione di strategia, dispersione/prestazioni, checklist di trading) per supportare sia la dovuta diligenza iniziale che il monitoraggio continuo.
• Partner tra le parti interessate per tradurre intuizioni in miglioramenti pragmatici per elaborare, controllare e risultati dei clienti, rafforzare la responsabilità e la trasparenza durante il ciclo di vita del programma.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Haben Sie eine Leidenschaft für die Anwendung quantitativer Methoden bei realen Investitionsherausforderungen? Gedeihen Sie in einem kollaborativen Umfeld, in dem Ihre Fähigkeiten im Bereich Portfoliokonstruktion und analytisches Denken Innovationen im Portfoliorisikomanagement vorantreiben können?

Wir suchen jemanden, der kann:

• Führen und dokumentieren Sie umfassende Überprüfungen von diskretionären Anlagestrategien, die von US-Finanzberatern (FAs) verwaltet werden, mit einem detaillierten Fokus auf Anlageprozess, Streuungsanalyse, Performance, Handelsimplementierung und damit verbundene operative Kontrollen.
• Engage Financial Advisor (FA) Teams, um Investment Manager Analysis (IMA) Beobachtungen zu erklären und gezieltes Coaching anzubieten, um ihre Anlageentscheidungen zu stärken und verbesserte langfristige Portfolioergebnisse zu erzielen.
• Beitrag zu wiederkehrenden Governance-Meetings / -Ausschüssen für diskretionäre Strategien; Festlegung von Tagesordnungen, Kuratierung von Materialien, Koordinierung der wichtigsten Stakeholder und Sicherstellung, dass Entscheidungen, Maßnahmen, Eigentümer und Zeitpläne klar erfasst werden; Eskalationen und Folgemaßnahmen zur Schließung.
• Als Fachexperte für unsere diskretionären Programme dienen; Feldfragen von FA-Teams und funktionsübergreifenden Partnern, die zeitnahe, gut unterstützte Anleitung zum Programmdesign, Aufsichtsstandards und Best Practices bieten.
• Beteiligen Sie sich an der Entwicklung der strategischen Vision für diskretionäre Programme, um robuste Aufsichts- und Governance-Rahmenbedingungen zu gewährleisten und gleichzeitig die Fähigkeit jeder FA zu erhalten, effektiv zu navigieren und diskretionäre Portfolios zu verwalten.
• Kuratieren und kontinuierlich verbessern Review-Artefakte (zB Strategie-Review-Pakete, Streuung / Performance-Lesungen, Handels-Checklisten), um sowohl erste Due Diligence und laufende Überwachung zu unterstützen.
• Partner aller Stakeholder, um Erkenntnisse in pragmatische Verbesserungen von Prozessen, Kontrollen und Kundenergebnissen umzusetzen und die Rechenschaftspflicht und Transparenz während des gesamten Programmlebenszyklus zu stärken.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Êtes-vous passionné par l'application de méthodes quantitatives aux défis de l'investissement réel? Profitez-vous dans un environnement collaboratif où vos compétences en construction de portefeuille et votre réflexion analytique peuvent stimuler l'innovation dans la gestion des risques de portefeuille?

Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui peut:

• Effectuer et documenter des examens exhaustifs des stratégies discrétionnaires d'investissement gérées par les conseillers financiers américains, en mettant l'accent sur le processus d'investissement, l'analyse de la dispersion, le rendement, la mise en oeuvre des opérations commerciales et les contrôles opérationnels connexes.
• Engager des équipes de conseillers financiers (FA) pour expliquer les observations du gestionnaire de l'analyse des investissements (IMA) et fournir un encadrement ciblé conçu pour renforcer leur prise de décision en matière d'investissement et favoriser l'amélioration des résultats à long terme du portefeuille.
• Contribuer aux réunions/comités de gouvernance récurrents pour les stratégies discrétionnaires; établir des ordres du jour, préparer du matériel, coordonner les principaux intervenants et veiller à ce que les décisions, les mesures, les propriétaires et les échéanciers soient clairement saisis; favoriser l'escalade et le suivi de la clôture.
• Servir d'expert en la matière pour nos programmes facultatifs; poser des questions sur le terrain aux équipes de l'AF et aux partenaires interfonctionnels, en fournissant des conseils opportuns et bien appuyés sur la conception des programmes, les normes de surveillance et les pratiques exemplaires.
• Participer à l'élaboration de la vision stratégique des programmes facultatifs afin d'assurer une surveillance et des cadres de gouvernance solides tout en préservant la capacité de chaque FA de naviguer et de gérer efficacement les portefeuilles discrétionnaires.
• Prévoir et améliorer continuellement les artefacts d'examen (p. ex., trousses d'examen de la stratégie, lectures de dispersion/performance, listes de contrôle des transactions) pour appuyer la diligence raisonnable initiale et la surveillance continue.
• Établir des partenariats entre les intervenants pour traduire les idées en améliorations pragmatiques aux processus, aux contrôles et aux résultats des clients, en renforçant la responsabilisation et la transparence tout au long du cycle de vie du programme.

jobs.title: Process and Quality Specialist
jobs.description:
Are you incredibly organized with an eye for detail? Do you have a high client service orientation and a high risk awareness? Do you like working with colleagues across the organization and are you good with stakeholder management? We're looking for someone like that to:
– Act as an Onboarding & KYC Advisor to client advisor on onboarding and Periodic KYC Review (PKR) cases across the WM. Understand and articulate KYC requirements and work with client advisor through the onboarding and PKR processes.
– Be proactive and respond timely to market and business partner’s queries. Facilitate exceptional handling on risk-based approach, and coordinate with Business and Financial Crime / Compliance for signoff.
Review background check screening on the client, provide support on client profile with client advisor, and gather corroboration evidence material where available. Support client advisor to ensure regulatory compliance of submitted materials from client and client advisor themself.
– Handle Periodic KYC Review (PKR) case review from start to end, including client profile updates after consulting with client advisor. Further, perform KYC profile checking activities linked to client onboarding requests and ensure client KYC information consistency with PKR Quality Checks.
– Support client advisor on non-KYC aspects of PKR (i.e. file conversion for archival, raise additional name search request to middle office, escalate for Due Diligence Officer (DDO) review, PKR case manager management.
• – Think flexibly to propose new ideas and contribute to continuous improvement of processes and services.
• – Be-able to act as mentor for junior teammates and cascade management message in an effective and accurate manner
• – Be a trusted partner of market as well as other business partners.

Supporto consulente clienti per garantire la conformità normativa dei materiali presentati dal cliente e dal consulente clienti stessi.

Inoltre, eseguire attività di controllo del profilo KYC collegate alle richieste di imbarco del cliente e garantire la coerenza delle informazioni del cliente KYC con i controlli di qualità PKR.
– Consulente client di supporto sugli aspetti non-KYC di PKR (cioè la conversione di file per l'archiviazione, sollevare richiesta di ricerca di nome aggiuntivo all'ufficio centrale, escalate for Due Diligence Officer (DDO) recensione, gestione case manager PKR.

Sind Sie unglaublich organisiert mit einem Auge für Details? Haben Sie eine hohe Kundendienstorientierung und ein hohes Risikobewusstsein? Arbeiten Sie gerne mit Kollegen in der gesamten Organisation zusammen und sind Sie gut mit Stakeholder Management? Wir suchen jemanden wie diesen, um:
Handeln Sie als Onboarding & KYC Advisor für Kundenberater bei Onboarding- und Periodic KYC Review (PKR) Fällen im gesamten WM. Verstehen und artikulieren Sie die KYC-Anforderungen und arbeiten Sie mit dem Kundenberater durch die Onboarding- und PKR-Prozesse.
Seien Sie proaktiv und reagieren Sie rechtzeitig auf die Anfragen von Markt- und Geschäftspartnern. Erleichtern Sie den außergewöhnlichen Umgang mit dem risikobasierten Ansatz und koordinieren Sie sich mit Business and Financial Crime / Compliance für die Abmeldung.
Überprüfen Sie das Hintergrundüberprüfungs-Screening auf dem Client, unterstützen Sie das Kundenprofil mit dem Kundenberater und sammeln Sie, soweit verfügbar, Nachweismaterial. Unterstützen Sie den Kundenberater, um die Einhaltung der von Kunden und Kundenberatern eingereichten Materialien selbst zu gewährleisten.
Behandeln Sie die periodische KYC Review (PKR) Fallprüfung von Anfang bis Ende, einschließlich Aktualisierungen des Kundenprofils nach Rücksprache mit dem Kundenberater. Führen Sie außerdem KYC-Profilprüfungsaktivitäten im Zusammenhang mit Client-Onboarding-Anfragen durch und stellen Sie sicher, dass die KYC-Informationen des Kunden mit den PKR-Qualitätsprüfungen übereinstimmen.
- Unterstützung des Kundenberaters bei Nicht-KYC-Aspekten von PKR (d. H. Dateikonvertierung für die Archivierung, zusätzliche Namenssuchanfrage an das Middle Office, Eskalation für die Überprüfung des Due Diligence Officer (DDO), PKR Case Manager Management.
• - Denken Sie flexibel, um neue Ideen vorzuschlagen und zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Prozessen und Dienstleistungen beizutragen.
• - in der Lage sein, als Mentor für Junior-Teamkollegen und Cascade-Management-Nachricht in einer effektiven und genauen Weise zu handeln
• - Seien Sie ein vertrauenswürdiger Partner des Marktes sowie anderer Geschäftspartner.
descriptionByLocale.fr:

Vous aimez travailler avec des collègues de l'ensemble de l'organisation et êtes-vous bon avec la gestion des intervenants? On cherche quelqu'un comme ça pour :
– Agir en tant que conseiller à bord et KYC auprès du conseiller client dans les cas d'inspection et d'examen périodique des KYC (PKR) dans l'ensemble du MG. Comprendre et articuler les exigences de KYC et travailler avec le conseiller client par l'entremise des processus de bord et de PKR.
– Soyez proactif et répondez en temps opportun aux questions du marché et des partenaires commerciaux. Faciliter la gestion exceptionnelle de l'approche fondée sur le risque, et coordonner avec la criminalité commerciale et financière / Conformité pour l'approbation.
Examiner la vérification des antécédents du client, fournir du soutien sur le profil du client avec le conseiller du client et recueillir des preuves de corroboration, le cas échéant. Appuyer le conseiller client pour assurer la conformité réglementaire des documents soumis par le client et le conseiller client lui-même.
– Gérer l'examen périodique des cas de KYC (PKR) du début à la fin, y compris les mises à jour du profil du client après avoir consulté le conseiller client. En outre, effectuer des activités de vérification de profil KYC liées aux demandes de client à bord et assurer la cohérence des informations KYC client avec les vérifications de qualité PKR.
– Soutenir le conseiller client sur les aspects non-KYC de PKR (c.-à-d. la conversion de fichiers pour les archives, soulever la demande de recherche de nom supplémentaire au bureau intermédiaire, augmenter pour l'examen de l'agent de diligence raisonnable (ODD), la gestion de cas de PKR.
• – Pensez avec souplesse pour proposer de nouvelles idées et contribuer à l'amélioration continue des processus et des services.
• – Être capable d'agir comme mentor pour les coéquipiers juniors et le message de gestion de cascade de manière efficace et précise
• – Être un partenaire de confiance du marché ainsi que d'autres partenaires commerciaux.

jobs.description:
Are you solid as a rock when delivering large projects with set deadlines and budget? Are you passionate about corporate real estate portfolio strategy? Do you know how to manage and motivate teams? Are you interested in sustainability topics, from environmental management to LEED certifications? Do you like to analyze complex data?

This role includes assisting the team with strategic planning and management of the real estate portfolio for all UBS AUS/NZ offices, includes all AUS/NZ premises projects and related activities for UBS. For the first 18 months this role will assume the responsibility of Project Sponsor for the new UBS Sydney office project. This will require leadership of the project team taking responsibility to deliver the new Sydney office to the agreed time frame and budget allocated.

Major responsibilities would include:

Real Estate:
- Involvement with Real estate short and long term strategy, negotiation with Landlord directly or through real estate consultants for any lease related transaction
- Real estate planning, space planning / optimisation solutions for changing with business requirements
- Prepare recommendation papers and seek property and cost approvals for minor works projects from UBS management within designated areas of responsibility and in line with limits of delegation
- Managing and vetting the AUS/NZ Rental Invoices on a monthly basis to ensure the data is accurate to recommend for approval
- The ongoing development and issuing of monthly occupancy space utilisation reports
- Ensure AUS/NZ comply with Regional requirements relating to the supervision of 3rd Party Real Estate providers

Projects and Churn Management:
- Manage all UBS AUS/NZ locations for projects including office fit-outs (new and old), churns, office refurbishment and office stacking
- Work closely with Real Estate team locally and regionally (business management included) to provide Real Estate support that is consistent and coherent with the global framework in each of the UBS offices
- Generate RFP's for tenders with fair value recommendations working with the Procurement team
- Programme management of projects allowing successful planning in line with operating procedures for each phase of work, from start through to handover
- Monitor & proactively recommend workplace asset replacement / refurbishment in line with lifecycle / workplace conditions
- Prepare recommendation papers for business cases defining costs and benefit analysis
- Manage all UBS AUS/NZ locations for reporting on space allocation and premise vacancy to be charged back and issued to business departments
- Consistent application of Real Estate related tools

Site Operations:
- Interact effectively with UBS internal business partners and establish a balanced engagement model with each of them and work with them in a professional and proactive challenging approach to ensure a balance between businesses requests and Real Estate strategy and policies.
- Manage all UBS AUS/NZ facilities operations on cost management, budget and forecasting
- Overall management of external Integrated Facilities Management service provider which includes SLA's to ensure KPI's are being achieved, monthly reporting, QBR reviews and performance management
- Manage all UBS AUS/NZ locations in corporate real estate and operations for incident management and escalation, business continuity / contingency planning
- Establish and maintain strong and effective working relationships with all business department managers
- Develop and maintain effective lines of communication to create best in class service delivery to all business partners and project stakeholders
- Manage and monitor regular workplace and condition inspections, ensuring the work items are appropriately instructed Include regular interaction with key business unit contacts to ensure satisfaction
- Provide managerial guidance to the local delivery teams and resolve first level enquiries
- WH&S ongoing development and management

jobs.title: SAP Group Reporting Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Responsable des rapports du groupe SAP

jobs.description:
The Group Reporting Delivery Lead supports the delivery of the SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting capability within the ampliFi program, with accountability for ensuring accurate, controlled, and timely group consolidation and reporting outcomes in line with UBS accounting principles and governance. The role is responsible for driving disciplined execution across functional design, business validation, testing readiness, and production transition for Group Reporting scope, ensuring that consolidation processes, results, and disclosures meet Group Finance expectations.
The role partners closely with Group Finance, Consolidation teams, Data, Integration, and Technology stakeholders and acts as a functional representative for Group Reporting within the delivery. It ensures that business requirements for consolidation and reporting are translated into robust, well‑controlled solutions aligned with the target finance architecture and close processes.

• support end‑to‑end functional delivery for assigned Group Reporting workstreams or modules within the ampliFi finance and reporting stack, with clear ownership of consolidation and reporting outcomes.
• contribute to and review functional designs and configurations to ensure alignment with agreed consolidation architecture, accounting policies, reporting requirements, and close timelines.
• ensure that Group Reporting solutions support accurate consolidation, including intercompany eliminations, currency translation, ownership structures, and group hierarchies.
• develop and maintain delivery plans covering functional scope, milestones, dependencies, and impacts across Group Reporting integration points, including inflows from FPSL and General Ledger and downstream reporting consumption.
• proactively manage risks, issues, and dependencies (RAID), with a focus on reporting accuracy, data integrity, close stability, and regulatory expectations, escalating where required.
• coordinate day‑to‑day delivery across Group Finance, Data, Integration, Testing, and Deployment teams to ensure coherent end‑to‑end execution aligned to consolidation and reporting cycles.
• ensure adherence to agreed delivery standards, accounting principles, design decisions, and change control processes across Group Reporting scope.
• support SIT and UAT execution from a functional perspective, including validation of consolidation scenarios, review of intercompany eliminations and adjustments, assessment of defects based on finance impact, and support for business sign‑off.
• assist with production readiness and cutover preparation, focusing on stability of close and consolidation cycles, accuracy of reported results, and smooth transition to business‑as‑usual operations post go‑live.
